description: Assign the current or given task plan to oneself or to somebody else, with assigning it to oneself tracking the AI usage (time, tokens, and costs) of the session until the task is given back, which adds the accumulated usage to the usage attachment of the task. Use when the user wants to "assign", "take", "pick up", "give back", "hand over", or "unassign" the "task" or "plan".
